_comment: Canonical listing store. Statuses reflect VERIFICATION state. Nothing may be promoted to status 'match' until beds, baths, acreage, pool AND active-on-market status have each been read off a live listing page or MLS record (see README 'Verification gate'). Search-engine snippets are for DISCOVERY ONLY - they index sold listings as 'For Sale' for years.

dataQuality.note: First run with live MLS access. Outbound HTTPS opened up this run, so the MetroList IDX feed at cherielliott.com (a Sierra Interactive site, feed timestamped 2026-10-26 06:30) and MLSListings.com MetroList records became readable. Every match below had its Pool-or-Spa field, lot acreage, bed/bath count and Active status read off a live record. The six properties replace the 2026-07-26 run's four false positives, all of which the user confirmed were off market.

sources.name: cherielliott.com (MetroList IDX, Sierra Interactive)
sources.role: primary verification - full Pool/Spa, acreage and status fields; city-exact result sets for Shingle Springs (26) and Rescue (21)

sources.name: coldwellbankerhomes.com
sources.role: Placerville inventory sweep - 239 results across 10 pages, yielded MLS numbers and Active/Pending status

sources.name: compass.com
sources.role: acreage-bearing city lists; sole source carrying the Bay East AOR listing at 2520 Bedford Ave

sources.name: WebSearch / Trulia / Homes.com pool filters
sources.role: DISCOVERY ONLY - never used for status

listings.blurb: Cheapest of the six and still clears every bar: 4bd/3ba on a flat 5 acres with an in-ground gunite pool. A detached 2bd/1ba guest cottage comes with it, which none of the others have. Pool field reads "Cover, Gunite, In Ground, Pool - Yes, Sweep".
listings.notes: Verified Active on the MLSListings MetroList record. A Trulia snapshot quoted $949,000; the live MLS record and Compass both say $829,000 - the $949K figure is stale and was not used.

listings.blurb: 4bd/3ba, 2,780 sqft on 5 acres with a built-in gunite pool. Best price-per-square-foot of the six matches. Pool field reads "Built-In, Gunite Construction, Private Pool".
listings.notes: Verified Active on the live MetroList IDX record. Surfaced only by the Coldwell Banker page sweep - the pool-filtered portal searches missed it, which is why the sweep was run to completion.

listings.blurb: The only Rescue property that clears every bar. Two-story custom home on 5.86 park-like acres, built-in gunite pool, plus a detached 3-car garage with ~750 sqft above it (game room, bonus room, bath). Views of Sacramento. The listing notes a major price reduction.
listings.notes: Verified Active on the live MetroList IDX record. Pool field: "Built-In, On Lot, Pool Sweep, Gunite Construction, Private Pool".

listings.blurb: 10.11 acres - second-largest parcel of the six - with a renovated 4bd/3ba home, upstairs game room with wet bar, remodeled quartz kitchen, whole-house generator. Backyard has pool, spa, waterfall and a gazebo outdoor kitchen. Room for ag or equestrian use.
listings.notes: Verified Active on the live MetroList IDX record. Pool field: "Built-In, Private Pool, Spa/Hot Tub Built-In, Spa". Solar is leased, not owned.

listings.blurb: 16.74 acres and the only 5-bedroom match. Resort-style infinity-edge pool with waterfall and spa, private gated entrance, built 2001. Permitted for short-term rental, and the parcel is large enough for a second home.
listings.notes: Listed on Bay East AOR (MLS 41150059), not MetroList - so it does NOT appear in the El Dorado IDX feeds and only Compass carries it. Verified Active at $1,275,000 on the Compass listing page, pool confirmed by its features list ("In Ground, Hot Tub/Spa, Fenced, On Lot, Pool/Spa Combo"). Older cached listings quote $1,469,000 (MLS 41081167) and $1,499,888 - both are prior listings, not the current one. Last sold Aug 2022 for $1,250,000.

listings.blurb: Single-story custom home on 5.03 acres, built 2003. Infinity-edge saltwater pool and spa with travertine surrounds and a separate outdoor shower and bath. Guest wing with its own bedroom, bath and private entrance. 20x30 workshop, 4-car garage, owned solar, generator, well and greenhouse.
listings.notes: Verified Active on the live MetroList IDX record. Pool field: "Built-In, Salt Water, Private Pool, Spa/Hot Tub Built-In, Spa". The most turnkey of the six, and priced accordingly.

listings.blurb: Active, 4bd on 2.66 acres with a built-in private pool, at $685,000. Misses on baths alone: 2.5, not 3. Flagging it because it is the cheapest pool-plus-acreage property in the three towns by a wide margin.
listings.notes: Verified Active. Pool field: "Built-In, Private Pool". Included only because the single missing half-bath is the sort of thing worth a judgement call rather than an automatic drop.

listings.blurb: Active, 4bd/4ba, 3,837 sqft with a built-in fenced pool and spa - the largest house among the near-misses. Fails on lot size: 1.76 acres against a 2.5-acre floor.
listings.notes: Verified Active. Pool field: "Built-In, Fenced, Private Pool, Spa/Hot Tub Built-In, Spa".

listings.blurb: Active, 5bd/3ba on 3.67 acres in Greenstone Country, in budget at $1,450,000. Clears everything except the pool - its Pool-or-Spa field reads "Spa/Hot Tub Personal, Spa", meaning a hot tub and no pool.
listings.notes: Verified Active. Worth knowing about if a pool could be added - the budget headroom is only $50K, though.

listings.blurb: Newly listed, 5bd/5ba, 4,313 sqft on 5 acres for $999,900 - the most house per dollar in the three towns. No pool at all, which is the only reason it isn't a match.
listings.notes: Verified Active (New For Sale), no Pool-or-Spa field on the record. Listed here because the space and acreage per dollar are unusual enough to be worth a look if adding a pool is on the table.
